_about: The living ICP (ideal customer profile) for the first Reign motion, versioned data. _provenance says for every field whether it came from the packet or was invented, and why. Invented fields were all decided by the operator (register rows named).

_provenance.unknown_employees: invented: hold for a human when headcount is unknown, because the motion is precision not volume (A-004, decided)
_provenance.agent_adoption: packet: 'already has agents in production or about to'; invented: a signal only, never a reason to exclude (A-036, decided)
_provenance.risk_committee: packet: unvetted Slack note from Rob; invented: a flag, not a gate (A-021, decided)
_provenance.unlisted_segment: invented: an account whose fit is unclear is held for a human; clearly outside the ICP is dropped with the reason audited (A-031, decided)
_provenance.fs_industries: invented: which industries count as financial services; unknown counts as FS and is flagged 'industry unconfirmed' (A-006, decided)
_provenance.exclusion_patterns: packet: 'Do not include mid-market SaaS', 'Remove [AI startups]' (A-003, decided); invented: the naming-variant patterns, widened after two independent QA passes (Q-005, Q-007)
_provenance.object_context_regex: invented: a match is ignored when the startups are the account's investees, partners or customers, not the account (D-016)
_provenance.segments.dsib_capital_markets: packet ICP sketch; invented: lanes risk and engineering (A-011, decided)
_provenance.segments.defense_supplier: packet ICP sketch; invented: lead with Forge (A-023, decided)
_provenance.segments.semiconductor: packet CEO notes; invented: a target only with a recorded US export-control problem, otherwise the watch list (A-039, decided)
_provenance.segments.hospital: packet Slack note 'do not spray hospitals this month'; invented: watch, don't contact (A-040, decided)
_provenance.watch_list: invented: accounts noticed and logged, never contacted (A-039, A-040, decided)

hospital.reason: Watch, don't contact: noticed and logged, no brief this month (A-040).
